unlisted_practices: Principle-guided scenario simulation to generate training dialogues for cognitive stimulation therapy
Multi-speaker context controller to resolve role confusion in group dialogue
Dynamic participant cognitive state modeling for personalized interaction
Cognitive stimulation-focused attention loss and multi-dimensional reward strategy to improve response quality

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an LLM-based conversational system (GCSD) for Group Cognitive Stimulation Therapy using simulated dialogues and real-world conversation datasets. It evaluates the architecture against baseline models rather than evaluating organizational deployment safeguards or practices.
